About

What is AutoLounge?

AutoLounge is an Android app that brings YouTube, 100+ live TV channels, streaming sites and radio to the Android Auto car screen. Video plays only while the car is parked; when it moves, the picture turns off and audio keeps playing. It is 100% free, open source, and needs no root.

How much does AutoLounge cost?

AutoLounge is 100% free and open source. There are no subscriptions, fees or paywalls.

Where do I get AutoLounge?

Download the APK directly from our GitHub Releases page. AutoLounge is open source and not on Google Play.

Which languages and countries does it support?

The app is available in 11 languages: Turkish, English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Arabic, Hindi and Chinese. The live TV list and home shortcuts adapt to your country based on your SIM or region.

Features

Engineered for Automotive Cockpits

Zero compromises. Built specifically for vehicle head units and cellular driving conditions.

YouTube 4K & Media Streaming

Stream YouTube videos, music, and podcasts on your car display with full desktop rendering, ad-cleaner acceleration, and zero lag.

100+ Live HD TV Channels

Instant access to national and international live television (BBC World News, Eurosport, Sky Sports, CNN International) with one-touch country filtering.

50s Cellular Buffer & Anti-Stall

Built-in ExoPlayer automotive buffer profile maintains playback across highway cell handovers and automatically recovers upon tunnel exit.

Smart Driving Safety Lockout

When the vehicle shifts out of PARK into Drive, video rendering is instantly blanked while audio streams uninterrupted through in-car speakers.

Real-Time Phone-to-Car Sync

Tap any video on your phone YouTube companion; AutoLounge instantly synchronizes and relays the stream to the vehicle screen.

Park Mode Web Cinema

Full-featured chromium browser with native hardware acceleration for Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Max, Twitch, and web cinema.

Companion app

Phone & Car Screen in Perfect Harmony

AutoLounge bridges your Android smartphone and your vehicle cockpit. Browse and search effortlessly on your phone; AutoLounge relays high-fidelity audio and video straight to your car display.

Setup guide for your Android version

On Android 15 and newer, AutoLounge opens on the car screen with just one Android Auto setting. Older versions need the app to look "installed by Google Play" (KingInstaller).

If the car screen says "No new messages during this drive", one of the steps below is missing.
1

Pick your Android version

Not sure? On your phone open Settings → About phone → Android version.

Selected automatically for your phone.
  1. Download the AutoLounge APK and install it normally.
  2. Turn on Android Auto "Unknown sources" (step 2). No extra installer is needed.
  3. AutoLounge appears on the car screen while parked; when the car moves the picture turns off and audio keeps playing.
  1. Install Shizuku from Google Play and start it with Wireless debugging.
  2. Download the latest KingInstaller (1.7 or newer).
  3. In KingInstaller enable "Shizuku Trick", then install the AutoLounge APK.
  4. Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO: Shizuku usually fails on these phones; only the root method is reliable.
Shizuku KingInstaller
  1. Download the AutoLounge APK and KingInstaller.
  2. Open KingInstaller, tap "Select file" and pick the AutoLounge APK.
  3. Choose "Install as Google Play Store".
KingInstaller
2

Turn on Android Auto "Unknown sources"

Open Android Auto settings on your phone:

SamsungSettings → Connected devices → Android Auto
Google PixelSettings → Connected devices → Connection preferences → Android Auto
Xiaomi / Redmi / POCOSettings → Connection & sharing → Android Auto
  1. Scroll down and tap "Version" 10 times, then confirm.
  2. Open ⋮ → Developer settings and tick "Unknown sources".
3

Reconnect and test

  1. Unplug the phone from the car and plug it back in (restart the phone if needed).
  2. Open the app list on the car screen and tap the AutoLounge icon.
Tip: the AutoLounge app checks all of this for you under Settings → Car Screen Setup Guide.
Troubleshooting

Something not working?

The most common problems and how to fix them in a minute.

Car screen says "No new messages during this drive"

Android Auto doesn't trust the app yet. Check step 2 ("Unknown sources") and, on Android 14 and below, make sure you installed with KingInstaller. Then reconnect the phone.

AutoLounge isn't in the car's app list

In Android Auto settings open "Customize launcher" and make sure AutoLounge is enabled. Unplug and replug the cable; if it still doesn't appear, restart the phone.

The picture goes black when I start driving

This is expected: the driving safety lockout hides video while the car is moving. Audio keeps playing, and the picture comes back when you park.

Shizuku won't start (Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO)

This is a known limitation of these phones on Android 14. If Shizuku keeps failing, only the root method works reliably.

My license key says "device limit reached"

Each license works on 2 phones. Enter your key on the new phone and deactivate the old device with one tap; the slot is freed instantly.

Still stuck?

Open AutoLounge on your phone → Settings → Car Screen Setup Guide. It checks every step and tells you which one is missing. Report an issue →

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about AutoLounge and Android Auto compatibility.

Do I need to root my phone?
No. AutoLounge works on stock, non-rooted Android phones. Android 15 and newer install normally; older versions use KingInstaller (see the setup guide).
Is AutoLounge completely free?
Yes. AutoLounge is 100% free and open-source software with no trials or payment gates.
Can I use it on multiple phones?
Yes! Since AutoLounge is completely open source and free, you can install it on as many devices as you like without any restrictions.
Does it void my car warranty?
Absolutely not. AutoLounge runs entirely on your Android smartphone and projects video/audio to your car screen using standard Android Auto projection protocols. No vehicle ECU or OBD modifications are made.
How does the cellular anti-stall buffer work in tunnels?
AutoLounge pre-buffers up to 50 seconds of video and audio using an optimized ExoPlayer cellular profile. When you enter a tunnel or encounter poor network coverage, playback continues seamlessly without stuttering.
Which Android versions are supported?
Android 15 and newer install normally and only need Android Auto "Unknown sources". Android 14 uses Shizuku with the KingInstaller "Shizuku Trick". Android 13 and below use KingInstaller "Install as Google Play Store".
Does the video play while I am driving?
No. Video plays only while the car is parked. When the car starts moving the picture turns off and audio keeps playing.
How many devices can I install it on?
Unlimited. You can install it on your phone, family phones, or spare devices without limits.
